section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants of a study, comprising 490 women from the Portuguese general population. Their mean age was 24.76 years, and their mean Body Mass Index (BMI) was 22.29, with a distribution reflecting the female Portuguese population (10.82% underweight, 71.22% normal weight, and 17.96% overweight).
section_summary.evidence_source: Four hundred and ninety women were collected from the Portuguese general population, with ages ranging from 18 to 54 years old (M = 24.76; SD = 7.66). Participants presented a Body Mass Index (BMI) mean of 22.29 (SD = 3.87), which corresponds to normal weight values (WHO, 1995). Fifty-three (10.82%) were underweight (BMI < 18.5), 349 (71.22%) presented normal weight values (18.5 ≥ BMI ≤ 25.0), and 88 (17.96%) were overweight (BMI > 25), which reflects the BMI distribution of the female Portuguese population (Poínhos et al., 2009).
